sections.name: learning_rate
sections.title: Which learning rate works best?
sections.description: Peak learning rates 1e-5, 2e-5 and 4e-5 with linear warm-up and decay, and a constant 2e-5. A linear schedule averages about half its peak, so the 4e-5 schedule is the closest match in average learning rate to the constant 2e-5.

sections.name: speaker_embedding
sections.title: Does the starting speaker embedding matter?
sections.description: Speakers 7 and 24 were ranked closest and furthest to LJ by ECAPA on the pretrained voices; 7 is low-pitched and 24 high-pitched. Speaker 2 is male and speaker 0 is the default. The embedding-only run trains nothing but the speaker vector (constant learning rate), so comparing it with the constant-rate full run (no_scheduler) shows how much the rest of the model contributes.

sections.name: regularisation_and_freezing
sections.title: Layer drop, feature-matching weight and freezing the text encoder
sections.description: Each run changes one setting from the default (no_droplayer).
